# nick-autoteknik

> Professional website for Nick Autoteknik, an auto repair shop in Rødovre, Denmark. Built with Next.js and Tailwind CSS.

## Project

- [GitHub Repository](https://github.com/cocodedk/nick-autoteknik)
- [Website](https://cocodedk.github.io/nick-autoteknik/)
- [Author](https://cocode.dk)

## Source

- [App pages](https://github.com/cocodedk/nick-autoteknik/tree/master/app)
- [Components](https://github.com/cocodedk/nick-autoteknik/tree/master/components)
- [README](https://github.com/cocodedk/nick-autoteknik/blob/master/README.md)
- [CLAUDE.md](https://github.com/cocodedk/nick-autoteknik/blob/master/CLAUDE.md)

## Stack

- Next.js (App Router, static export), TypeScript, Tailwind CSS
- Netlify deployment, Playwright (e2e tests)
